besluite.rede: 'net so goed deel van' is idiomatic Afrikaans for 'equally/just as much part of' and cannot be misread here, while 'net soveel deel van' leans towards the English 'just as much part of', so the proposal is no improvement.
The distributive singular ('hul deel', one part each) is normal Afrikaans and matches the lists' 'die Suid-Afrikaanse deel'; 'dele' adds nothing and could suggest several parts per park.
